charts.title: L 168-9 b: orbits around L 168-9
charts.description: The orbits of L 168-9's planets in this map from above, to scale, with L 168-9 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hobson et al. 2024 (2024A&A...688A.216H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOBSON_ET_AL_2024): P 1.40152604 d

charts.title: L 168-9 b: its transit
charts.description: L 168-9 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (102, 104, 105) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 234994474, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
